# telnyx_ai_conversation_insights (Data Source)

Lists ai conversation insights, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_ai_conversation_insight`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `ai_conversation_insights` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ai_conversation_insights))

<a id="nestedatt--ai_conversation_insights"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ai_conversation_insights`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String)
- `insight_type` (String)
- `instructions` (String)
- `json_schema` (String) If specified, the output will follow the JSON schema. A JSON document; use `jsondecode()` to read it.
- `name` (String)
- `webhook` (String)
